name: Sorcerer
source: Pathfinder GM Core, "Building Creatures", Class Road Maps, via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/Rules.aspx?ID=2874
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder GM Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: Low Perception; moderate bloodline skills and high Charisma-based bloodline skills; high Cha; low AC; low Fortitude; low HP; low accuracy; high to extreme spell DC. Abilities: Spontaneous spellcasting of a tradition based on bloodline as a sorcerer of their level, bloodline and related feats and spells

notes.skills: Moderate bloodline skills; high Charisma-based bloodline skills.
notes.defense: Low AC; low Fortitude; low HP.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC. Spontaneous spellcasting of its bloodline's tradition as a sorcerer of its level: {maxrank}. Bloodline spells.
